observations: Photo 0 shows a front-load washing machine with 'LG' logo clearly visible on top left of control panel.
Panel text reads 'INVERTER DirectDrive 6/3kg' and a red badge says 'Washer+Dryer 2 in 1'.
Display panel shows lit indicator lights and a glowing dial, suggesting the unit has power connected to it.
Machine is sitting on a pedestal/dryer base, drum door closed, some clothes visible inside drum.
No visible damage, rust, or missing parts in the single photo; unit looks physically intact from the front.
Only one photo supplied; no back panel, plug, serial plate, or power-on test shown.

claims.evidence: Photo 0 clearly shows 'LG' logo and LG model branding, not Samsung.

claims.claim: Washing machine scrap but doesn't work and needs repair
claims.evidence: No power-on/drum-spin video or test clip provided; display lights visible in photo 0 could mean partial power, but working state of motor/drum cannot be confirmed from a still photo.

risks.risk: Seller's text names a different brand (Samsung) than what is shown in the photo (LG), raising doubt about which unit is actually being sold or whether listing details were copied from elsewhere.
risks.proof: A fresh photo of the same unit's rating plate/serial sticker (usually on the back or side) matching the brand and model claimed.
risks.if_unproven: priced as the item actually shown in the photo (LG), not as claimed (Samsung), and treated as a mismatch risk lowering confidence

risks.risk: Actual functional state unknown beyond seller's claim of 'doesn't work' — could be totally dead (motherboard/motor dead) or only a minor fault (belt, pump), which changes scrap/repair value a lot.
risks.proof: Video of plugging in and attempting a wash cycle, or at minimum power-on with door lock engaging.
risks.if_unproven: priced at worst case: fully non-functional, scrap/parts value only

risks.risk: Hidden damage to drum, bearings, or internal electronics not visible from a single front-facing photo.
risks.proof: Additional photos of the back panel, drum interior, and underside/motor area.
risks.if_unproven: priced as if hidden internal damage exists (worst case)

risks.risk: Missing accessories (hoses, power cable, detergent drawer) could add repair/replacement cost.
risks.proof: Photo showing power cable, inlet/outlet hoses attached.
risks.if_unproven: priced as missing until shown present

proof_requests: Close-up photo of the rating plate/serial sticker (usually rear or inside door frame) to confirm actual brand and model.
Video of the unit being plugged in, showing any power response, door lock, or drum movement attempt.
Photo of the back of the unit showing hoses, power cable, and overall condition.
Photo of the drum interior and detergent drawer area for wear/damage.
response.reason: The seller's own words claim the brand is Samsung, but the photo unambiguously shows an LG-branded unit with LG model markings, a direct contradiction that raises concern about listing accuracy or a possible mismatched/scam advert.
